reason: Two very close, honest, on-brief answers; Output 2 tells me more I didn't know — the yearly-billing lever and its real trade-off — and its test measures MRR per account, which is what I'd actually watch, while Output 1 is a little easier to hand to the team and tighter to the 'one recommendation' ask.
